meta.title: Submitting the proposal sends it into the approval workflow
gaps: approvers having tasks cannot be checked directly through the sourcing event vocabulary

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “proposals[0] › status” equals requested.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “proposals[0] › status” equals requested.
